# Nimbus Normalization Scan

## Scan scope

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `markers` | `Optional[List[str]]` | `null` | `basic` | Optional marker subset to scan; null uses all rows from a baseline CSV when supplied, otherwise every channel available in all usable ROIs. | Use a small scan-parameter CSV or an explicit marker list to keep repeated GPU inference focused. |
| `rois` | `Optional[List[str]]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional explicit ROI subset used for repeated Nimbus inference. | When set, these ROI names take precedence over max_rois and must be present after Nimbus input discovery. |
| `roi_selection_strategy` | `Literal['marker_expression_range', 'random']` | `marker_expression_range` | `basic` | Automatic ROI-selection strategy used independently for each marker when rois is null. | marker_expression_range spreads selections from low to high mean intracellular input signal above the marker lower threshold; random preserves the earlier seeded cohort-wide sampling behavior. |
| `max_rois` | `int` | `10` | `basic` | Maximum ROIs selected per marker for repeated inference; zero uses every usable ROI. | Normalization baselines still use all usable ROIs. With marker_expression_range, different markers can use different ROI subsets. |
| `random_seed` | `int` | `0` | `advanced` | Seed for reproducible ROI sampling when roi_selection_strategy is random. | - |

## Vmax candidates

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `baseline_normalization_dict_path` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `basic` | Optional CSV supplying marker, baseline Vmax, and lower-threshold rows; when markers is null, its rows also define the scan marker subset. Legacy Nimbus JSON remains readable for baseline values. | Preferred columns are marker, baseline_vmax, and lower_threshold. Vmax factors remain in config. Relative paths resolve from the project root and the source file is never overwritten. |
| `vmax_factors` | `List[float]` | `[0.25, 0.3535533905932738, 0.5, 0.7071067811865476, 1.0, 1.4142135623730951, 2.0, 2.8284271247461903, 4.0]` | `basic` | Positive factors multiplied by each marker's baseline Vmax to form its default log-spaced scan. | The default covers one quarter to four times baseline in half-octave steps. |
| `marker_baseline_vmax` | `Dict[str, float]` | `{}` | `basic` | Optional marker-to-baseline-Vmax mapping; vmax_factors are multiplied by each supplied value. | Use this for a current normalization dictionary written directly in config; markers omitted here use the baseline dictionary path or computed quantile. |
| `marker_lower_thresholds` | `Dict[str, float]` | `{}` | `basic` | Optional marker-to-lower-threshold mapping in absolute input-intensity units; omitted markers use zero. | Values at or below the threshold map to normalized zero. Every threshold must remain below all Vmax candidates scanned for that marker. |
| `marker_vmax_values` | `Dict[str, List[float]]` | `{}` | `advanced` | Optional marker-to-explicit-Vmax mapping overriding vmax_factors for selected markers. | Each marker override needs at least three distinct positive values to estimate local sensitivity. |

## Interpretation

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `positive_score_thresholds` | `List[float]` | `[0.25, 0.5, 0.75]` | `basic` | Nimbus cell-score thresholds whose positive-cell proportions are plotted across Vmax candidates. | These are sensitivity views, not universal biological positivity cutoffs. |
| `primary_positive_score_threshold` | `float` | `0.5` | `basic` | Nimbus score threshold used for call-flip, cliff, stability, and recommendation diagnostics. | Validate this threshold against marker images or controls; Nimbus scores are not universally calibrated. |

## Recommendation diagnostics

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stability_tolerance` | `float` | `0.05` | `advanced` | Maximum adjacent change in primary positive-cell fraction per two-fold Vmax change for a stable candidate. | - |
| `call_flip_tolerance` | `float` | `0.05` | `advanced` | Maximum fraction of individual cells whose primary call may flip across either adjacent Vmax step for a stable candidate. | This prevents balanced positive-to-negative and negative-to-positive swaps from looking stable merely because the total positive proportion is unchanged. |
| `saturation_tolerance` | `float` | `0.05` | `advanced` | Maximum fraction of in-mask input pixels clipped at normalized value 1 for a stable candidate. | - |
| `cliff_tolerance` | `float` | `0.15` | `advanced` | Adjacent primary positive-fraction shift at which a marker is flagged as having a Vmax cliff. | - |

## Outputs

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `save_cell_scores` | `bool` | `True` | `advanced` | Write one compressed per-cell score table per marker for detailed review and reproducibility. | Disable to reduce report size; aggregate, ROI, recommendation, and figure outputs are always retained. |
